name: oidc basic
note: Caveat Wave B OIDC trust-anchor holder-consent canonical bytes. Field order is domain(oidc), actor_oid, tenant_id, issuer, oidc_subject, consent_pubkey, nonce, not_after_ms. Each field is length-prefixed LP(s)=byteLength(s)+':'+s. This is the actor's holder-of-key proof over the actor-controlled Ed25519 consent key; the trusted-issuer id_token independently vouches subject==actor.

name: oidc delimiter (a,bc)
note: Delimiter-injection: paired with (ab,c). Length-prefixing keeps actor='a',tenant='bc' distinct from actor='ab',tenant='c'. A colon inside any field cannot forge a field boundary.

name: oidc unicode subject
note: Length prefix is measured in UTF-8 BYTES: 'subé' is 4 code points but 5 bytes, and 'oid:actor:é' is 12 bytes.
